description_en: Queries the information about a video clip task
name: GetEditingJobInfo

parameters.help_en:
The production studio ID.

If you created the production studio by calling the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2848009.html operation, check the CasterId parameter in the response.

If you created the production studio in the ApsaraVideo Live console, navigate to ApsaraVideo Live console > Production Studios > Cloud Production Studio to view the ID.

The name of the production studio in the production studio list on the Cloud Production Studio page is the production studio ID.
CasterId must be a production studio with NormType=6 (playlist mode). Using a production studio with other NormType values (such as 1 or 3) returns InvalidShowList.NotFound. You can filter by NormType=6 in the DescribeCasters response
parameters.help_zh:
导播台ID。

如果您通过https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2848009.html创建导播台，请查看CreateCaster接口调用返回的参数CasterId值。

如果您通过直播控制台创建导播台，请通过直播控制台 > 导播台 > 云导播台页面查看。

直播控制台云导播台页面导播台列表中的导播台名称即导播台ID。
CasterId 必须为 NormType=6（新播单型/轮播台）导播台，使用其他 NormType（如 1、3）的导播台将返回 InvalidShowList.NotFound，可在 DescribeCasters 返回结果中按 NormType=6 过滤
parameters.name: caster_id

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the show to query.
You can obtain the ShowId value from the response of the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/370861.html operation
parameters.help_zh:
需要查询的节目ID。
通过查看https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/370861.html接口的返回参数获取ShowId值
parameters.name: show_id

EditingTasksInfo.description_en:
The video clip task information. This includes:

OutputVodId: The ID of the output video-on-demand file.

TaskStatus: The status of the video clip task. (-1: failed. 0: task initialized. 1: clipping in progress. 2: uploading. 3: task succeeded.)

StorageLocation: The video-on-demand storage address.

FileName: The name of the clipped file.

ShowId: The show ID
EditingTasksInfo.description_zh:
剪辑任务信息。包含：

OutputVodId：输出的Vod文件ID。

TaskStatus：剪辑任务状态。（-1：失败；0：任务初始化；1：剪辑中；2：上传中；3：任务成功。）

StorageLocation：点播存储地址。

FileName：剪辑文件名。

ShowId：节目ID
